note: D-THR measure->record->ratchet retrieval threshold for the deterministic absence pass (RECALL-01). Tuned on the mvr1381 TUNING corpus (D-GEN1: never the held-out spec32s41 witness). The reciprocal_rank_fusion top score is bounded by 2/(60+1)=0.0328 when the same chunk tops both the BM25 and dense legs; the real mvr1381 per-trigger top score measured 0.03178. The threshold 0.04 sits ABOVE that ceiling so every applicable requirement over-emits (D-ABS2 recall-bias: over-emit, Phase-7 verifier prunes), recovering absence_of_evidence above the 0.000 floor (SC2). The absence-gate READS this threshold (never a code constant, D-THR) and enforces the non-held-out aggregate absence_recall stays > 0.000 and >= non_held_out_aggregate.absence_recall.
